row.notes: NeSaveSystem2Win (vt_Ne_SaveSystem2Win 0x145a5c640) slot +0x08, called once, from Ne_SaveSystem_InitDevice 0x144137890 right after it builds the device (save system +0x490) and, with g_Ne_SaveSteamEnabled set, its Steam helper (device +0x30; helper +0x108 = ISteamRemoteStorage v016 from k_Ne_SteamRemoteStorageContext, helper +0x00 = char[0x104] from ISteamUser022 GetUserDataFolder). Start itself never touches the helper: it allocates the 64 KB work buffer (+0x330), the two cipher objects (+0x338 vtable 0x145a5f1f0, +0x340 vtable 0x145a5f230, both keyed from device+0x20), inits the uploader at +0x268 and logs Save system started, save folder is %s from device+0x18 -> +0x70. Remote storage slots the device calls through helper+0x108 (whole-exe scan, core.md#save-sandbox): FileWrite +0x00, FileRead +0x08, FileDelete +0x30, FileExists +0x68, GetFileSize +0x78, GetFileTimestamp +0x80, GetFileCount +0x90, GetFileNameAndSize +0x98, BeginFileWriteBatch +0x1c8, EndFileWriteBatch +0x1d0. Corrected 2026-10-28 (ts3): the earlier note said only +0x90/+0x98. The install point of the swofty test save sandbox. Raised by native-1990 for the F1 1990 save separation (doc:/mnt/work/.f1-1990/addon/native-requests.md#N2). The two cipher objects are AES-256-ECB stream filters (vt 0x145a5f1f0 encrypt via 0x143f77b80 per block, vt 0x145a5f230 decrypt via 0x143f77f40); their +0x30 is the AES context built at Game_Read_GameConfig 0x1407f9f88 (key setter 0x143f427c0, hex-string key) and passed to the save system constructor 0x144137460, which stores it at save system +0x2d0. The key string is 64 digits from an MT19937 (seed 0x178b102d, outputs mod 15). It is a constant, not derived from an account or title id. Used only for the SECUINFO index.
